high_level_description: This image depicts the exterior of an arcade at night. The focal point is a large, illuminated neon sign that reads "ARCADE" in bold, orange letters with a white outline. The sign features a sunburst design in the background, adding to its retro aesthetic. Below the main sign, there is a smaller, rectangular yellow box mounted on a pole. The arcade building itself has a corrugated metal facade and a covered entrance area supported by yellow beams. Inside the arcade, some people can be seen, though their activities are not clearly discernible from this distance.
